Subject: Approval request: starter subsidy for FrankTech (self-serve) & follow-up plan

Team —

Quick ask: FrankTech (trial signup yesterday) is requesting a self-serve starter subsidy so they can run a short evaluation across two feature teams. They came in via the PLG funnel and quoted a small PoC that would consume roughly 30k tokens over 14 days (~$3k list-equivalent). Their end goal is a near-term pilot (Q3) if latency/cost looks good.

Why I recommend approval:
- Origin: organic signup, company fits our midmarket POC profile (SaaS search + vector store).
- Likely upside: engineering-led eval, sales signal strong (they already asked about Dedicated later).
- Low risk: data is non-sensitive; standard self-serve T&Cs apply.

Proposed ask:
- Issue a 30k-token starter subsidy (applied as self-serve promo code / account grant).
- Monitor usage for 21 days; if activity < 20% of expected, escalate for targeted onboarding.

Attachments: franktech-eval-plan.pdf (lightweight eval plan they shared).

Next steps I need from you: approval to issue the subsidy and request Ops to record an issuance id + add a HubSpot activity. I can lead the follow-up outreach if Ops provides the issuance confirmation.

Thanks —
Logan

Thanks again for signing up and confirming the eval plan. I wanted to make the onboarding as frictionless as possible now that the starter subsidy is live (Issuance ID FRK-ISS-78923). Logan
